mentions.h: Belgrave's top British League points scorers 1969-2002
mentions.note: British League points to end 2002: 56 from 5 matches

mentions.h: They've done it again! National 12-Stage title retained
mentions.note: stage 12, fastest stage; better known as an 800/1500 runner

mentions.h: Centre pages: Kings of the Road
mentions.note: stage 12, 6th fastest short stage, took Belgrave to the tape

mentions.h: Bels rampant at Rushmoor – a fourth successive win

photos.c: Top right: A new name in the Belgrave road squad - Adam Zawadski. An international on the track at 1500m, Adam had to run a time trial to get into the team and then ran 6th fastest short stage of the day to take the "claret and gold" to the tape.

Bottom right: The victorious Belgrave crew can't stop smiling after retaining their title. Standing: Jonathan Blackledge (stage 6), Al Stewart (11), Kevin Nash (3), Adam Zawadski (12), Martin Dent (7), Paul Freary (1), Paul Evans (9 - and what proved to be his last team run for Belgrave), David Anderson (4). Kneeling: Allen Graffin (5), Will Cockerell (10), Alan Mead (team manager), Richard Ward (8), Stephen Sharp (2).
